Stats

Werewolf
Duver Rillyn is a Werewolf in the ballroom of Cazador Szarr's palace.

Involvement

After entering the ballroom, another werewolf named  Gheris Hhune starts a conversation with the party. The conversation always results in a combat encounter, with Duver joining the fight as well.
